Title: Duplicate quiz question appears in Easy and Medium
Reproduction: Run the cross-difficulty duplicate scan against all generated quiz rows.
Expected: No question is repeated across difficulty levels for one species.
Actual: Retest found zero cross-difficulty duplicates across 6,840 questions and 152 species.

Title: Battle regression suite disagrees with tuned opening shield
Reproduction: Run the two previously failing tests in test_battle_rules.py.
Expected: Both tests pass against the agreed opening-shield rule.
Actual: Both still fail: actual HP 25/83 versus expected 23/81.

Title: AI threat assessment omits child Energy and available abilities
Reproduction: Vary child Energy and unlocked abilities while holding the remaining state constant; compare state key and action score.
Expected: Decision considers child Energy, available abilities, costs/effects and future threat.
Actual: State key and action score remain identical after child Energy and abilities are removed.

Title: AI evaluation is not representative across HP/Energy states
Reproduction: Inspect make_match/evaluate and execute a seeded evaluation.
Expected: Evaluation explicitly covers low/full HP, low/high Energy, habitat advantage states, unlock states, cards, initiative and opponent profiles.
Actual: Evaluation still varies cards/habitats/unlocks/initiative/profile but starts each match at full HP and 5 Energy.

Title: AI outlier review is incomplete
Reproduction: Run policy evaluation and inspect retained reports.
Expected: Win rate, length, action/ability use and persistent card/habitat outliers are reviewed with findings retained.
Actual: Metrics print to stdout; no retained, completed persistent-outlier or ability-concentration review exists.

Title: No evidenced release review of consistently unbalanced AI behaviour
Reproduction: Inspect repository reports and release evidence after representative AI evaluation.
Expected: Persistent imbalance triggers a documented policy or battle-balance review before release.
Actual: No completed release-review artefact is present.

Title: Frontend dependency audit reports critical/high vulnerabilities
Reproduction: Run npm ci, then npm audit --json.
Expected: No unresolved critical or high dependency vulnerabilities at release gate.
Actual: 30 total: 0 critical, 18 high and 12 moderate. Critical is cleared, but the high-severity gate still fails.
